title: Tenant-scoped differential backfill with consistency hooks and dry-run shadowing
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Implement a tenant-scoped differential backfill operator for console analytics that safely replays historical usage events while being aware of schema evolution. The operator will run per-tenant segments, produce checkpointed resume tokens, and include consistency hooks that validate idempotency and write correctness before committing reprocessed records to production tables. Key goals: minimize blast radius, support dry-run shadowing, provide cost estimates, and integrate with existing backfill orchestration APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can run a backfill for a single tenant and produce a resume cursor token that encodes partition, watermark, and schema-version
Dry-run mode writes transformed events to shadow_<table> (no swap) and exposes a reconciliation diff report
Consistency hooks compute a deterministic hash for each entity stream and validate post-backfill hashes match expected values or surface drift
Operator supports tenant-level throttling and global budget enforcement to avoid saturating runtime or causing SLA regressions
End-to-end integration test demonstrates backfill of a multi-day window for 10 synthetic tenants within size/cost estimates
Observability: backfill_id, tenant_id, records_processed, estimated_cost_millis, and final_status emitted to console-backfills Grafana dashboard
tasks: Write design doc: operator API, resume cursor format (base64 JSON with partition/timestamp/schema_version), and safety semantics
Prototype dry-run shadow pipeline to write to shadow_<table> and generate reconciliation diffs
Implement tenant-scoped rate limiter that uses token-buckets with per-tenant QPS and a global compute budget
Implement consistency hooks: deterministic per-entity hashing and snapshot fingerprint comparison
Add checkpointing/metrics: periodic resume token flushes and progress heartbeats
Create integration tests with synthetic telemetry generator and schema-evolution scenarios
Add cost estimator that projects compute time and storage for a proposed backfill window
Docs: operator runbook, paged troubleshooting steps, and canary checklist
